title: UK Standard Visitor visa from Pakistan
source_notes: DRAFT — AI-assembled from published UK Visitor Rules (Appendix V) and UKVI guidance. NOT verified against live casework.

The UK sets NO fixed financial threshold for visitors. The per-day figure in this pack is an internal heuristic for spotting obviously thin files, NOT an official requirement — say so in any client-facing wording.
UKVI decides on the balance of probabilities across the whole file, so 'genuine visitor' judgement matters more here than any single document.
TB testing: applicants from Pakistan applying for more than 6 months require an IOM TB certificate. Standard visitor stays of up to 6 months normally do not.
Verify against the current Appendix V and the online application journey before relying on any finding.
disclaimer: This is a document completeness check against a named checklist. It is not immigration advice and does not predict whether a visa will be granted.

fx.note: Indicative rates for threshold comparison only. Edit in /admin/rules.

documents.label: Passport
documents.why: The passport bio-data page is the identity anchor for the whole application.
documents.fix: Upload a clear scan of the bio-data page including the two machine-readable lines at the bottom.

documents.label: Bank statement (6 months)
documents.why: UKVI assesses whether you can meet the cost of the trip without working or accessing public funds. Six months of statements is the norm caseworkers expect.
documents.fix: Obtain bank statements covering the last 6 months, stamped by the bank, showing your name and the closing balance.

documents.label: Cover letter
documents.why: The visitor route turns on whether the caseworker believes you are a genuine visitor who will leave. A cover letter is where that case is made.
documents.fix: Write a one-page letter stating your purpose, dates, accommodation, who is funding the trip, and your reasons to return to Pakistan.

documents.label: Flight reservation
documents.why: UKVI does not require a purchased ticket and advises against buying one before a decision. A reservation or a stated itinerary still helps evidence intent to leave.
documents.fix: Include a provisional itinerary or reservation. Do not buy a non-refundable ticket before the decision.

documents.label: Proof of accommodation
documents.why: You must show where you will stay for the duration of the visit.
documents.fix: Add a hotel booking, or an invitation letter from your host in the UK with their address.

documents.label: Employment letter / NOC
documents.why: Employment with approved leave is the strongest ordinary evidence that you will return to Pakistan.
documents.fix: Ask your employer for a letter on letterhead confirming your role, salary, service dates, and approved leave for the travel period.

documents.label: Salary slips
documents.why: Salary slips corroborate that the credits in your bank statement are genuine earnings.
documents.fix: Add your last 3 to 6 salary slips.

documents.label: Business registration / NTN certificate
documents.why: Self-employed applicants must evidence the business that funds the trip and that they will return to.
documents.fix: Include your business registration or NTN certificate together with your most recent tax return.

documents.label: Tax return
documents.why: A filed return substantiates declared business income.
documents.fix: Add your most recent FBR tax return acknowledgement.

documents.label: Enrolment / bonafide certificate
documents.why: Students must evidence current enrolment and that they are expected back.
documents.fix: Ask your institution for a bonafide certificate confirming enrolment and no objection to your travel.

documents.label: Pension statement
documents.why: Retired applicants must evidence their ongoing income.
documents.fix: Include your pension payment order or recent pension credit statements.

documents.label: Sponsor letter (if someone else is funding the trip)
documents.why: If a third party pays, UKVI expects their commitment in writing plus their own financial evidence.
documents.fix: Ask your sponsor for a letter confirming what they will cover, with their bank statements and proof of their UK status if they are resident there.

documents.label: Property or asset documents
documents.why: Assets in Pakistan support the case that you intend to return.
documents.fix: Consider adding property papers or other asset documentation.

documents.label: Previous visas / travel history
documents.why: Prior compliant travel, especially to the UK, US, Schengen, Australia or Canada, is among the strongest positive signals for this route.
documents.fix: Include copies of previous visas and entry/exit stamps.

rules.title: Your name is not written the same way on every document
rules.fix: Every document must show your name exactly as in your passport. Ask any third-party issuer to reissue documents with the correct spelling.

rules.title: Date of birth does not match across documents
rules.passed_label: Date of birth matches across documents
rules.fix: Correct the date of birth to match your passport exactly.

rules.title: Passport validity
rules.passed_label: Passport is valid for the whole visit
rules.fix: Your passport must be valid for the whole of your stay in the UK. Renew it before applying if it expires during the trip.

rules.title: Funds look thin for the trip length
rules.passed_label: Funds look adequate for the trip length
rules.fix: The UK sets no official minimum, but the caseworker must believe you can cover the trip without working. Either show a stronger balance, or evidence a sponsor with their own statements and a letter of support.

rules.title: Bank statement history length
rules.passed_label: Bank statement covers the expected period

rules.title: Sudden large deposit
rules.passed_label: No single deposit dominates the balance
rules.fix: UKVI specifically probes unexplained deposits. Include documentary proof of where the money came from, or a sponsor's affidavit if it was a gift.

rules.title: No proof of income for your stated status
rules.detail: You selected 'employed', so the file needs documentary proof of that employment.
rules.fix: Add an employment letter, recent salary slips, or your tax return.

rules.title: Accommodation does not start by your arrival date
rules.passed_label: Accommodation dates line up with your itinerary
rules.fix: Extend the booking so it covers every night of the visit.

criteria.label: Cover letter does not address why you will return to Pakistan
criteria.passed_label: Cover letter addresses intent to return
criteria.question: Does the letter give concrete reasons the applicant will leave the UK at the end of the visit — employment to return to, business, dependants, study, or property? Vague statements of intent do not count.
criteria.fix: Add a paragraph with specifics: your job and the date you return to work, family who depend on you, and any business or property you hold in Pakistan.

criteria.label: Cover letter does not explain who is funding the trip
criteria.question: Does the letter state clearly who is paying for the trip and how those funds were accumulated?
criteria.fix: State plainly whether you are self-funding or being sponsored, and where the money came from.

criteria.label: Cover letter does not set out the itinerary
criteria.passed_label: Cover letter sets out the itinerary
criteria.question: Does the letter state the intended arrival and departure dates and what the applicant will do during the visit?
criteria.fix: Add your intended dates and a short day-level outline of the visit.

criteria.label: Employment letter is missing details caseworkers expect
criteria.passed_label: Employment letter contains the expected details
criteria.question: Does the letter state the applicant's job title, salary, length of service, approved leave dates, and confirm they are expected to return to work? List which are absent.
criteria.fix: Ask your employer to reissue the letter covering job title, salary, service length, approved leave dates, and your expected return-to-work date.

criteria.label: Invitation letter does not evidence the host's UK status
criteria.passed_label: Invitation letter references the host's UK status
criteria.question: Does the letter reference the host's own immigration status in the UK, such as British citizenship, settled status or a visa, and their address?
criteria.fix: Ask your host to state their UK status and address, and to attach a copy of their passport or residence document.

criteria.label: Sponsor letter does not evidence the sponsor's capacity to pay
criteria.passed_label: Sponsor letter addresses capacity to pay
criteria.question: Does the letter state the sponsor's income or financial position and specifically which costs they will cover?
criteria.fix: Ask the sponsor to state their income, what they will pay for, and to attach their own bank statements.
